notes: Every `[qr-gitlab:all local=true]` push triggers GitLab project 87152020 pipelines on saas-macos-medium-m1 runners; results return as GitHub `GitLab pipeline` checks plus `gitlab-all-<pipelineId>` artifacts.

Pre-06:00 pipelines failed ~3 min in on every 0b branch. Root cause found via qr/diag-lfs-probe bisection: PR 0a contract modules imported `@aura3d/rendering/contracts*` and `@aura3d/engine-runtime*` specifiers that had no vite alias entries; vite's prefix-match aliases rewrote them onto `packages/*/src/index.ts/...` and every real bundle build (game --build-only, benchmarks ci.sh vite build) died with ENOTDIR. Fixed on all four PR branches by adding the tsconfig-mirrored subpath aliases to vite.config.ts (commits 269768a8 / 43653ddc / 638462ce / ec8c4c57). 18/18 game builds and the benchmark build verified locally post-fix.

GitHub Actions run ids for the Quality Rebuild Capture sentinel runs are not retrievable without a GitHub API token in this environment; the triggering commit SHAs are recorded instead (the workflow runs on pushes to aura3d-quality-rebuild/audit only).
